Thanks for walking us through the onboarding checklist this morning. Per our conversation, attached are the documents to complete our payments enrollment:

- bank_letter_upscale.pdf (bank letter on bank letterhead; confirms account ownership)
- remit_sample_v1.csv (example remittance rows with invoice-number, PO, line-item tags)

Please let me know if you need any additional proof (micro-deposit confirmation, voided check) or if the remittance CSV needs specific PO-field mapping for Redwood. We can provide a small sample of invoices if that helps.

Hi Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Uploading these into our vendor onboarding queue now; a few quick follow-ups so we can finish the setup end-to-end: 

1) Finance (cc'd Marissa) usually requires either a micro-deposit confirmation or a voided check to pair with the bank letter for ACH routing confirmation. If you can provide a voided check PDF that would speed things up, otherwise we will request a micro-deposit test.

2) Remit CSV: the structure looks good. One ask — can the CSV include a separate field named PO_TYPE (values: PO, SOW, NONPO) so our invoice parser can tag non-PO items? If it's not possible right now, we can map PO in a fixed column but want to avoid manual mapping on high-volume months.

3) Can you confirm the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the Redwood vendor record? We need it for 1099 handling.

I will start a vendor record and share the vendor ID back to you once created. Goal: have them in the system and ready for first payment by Dec 15. Marissa — can you pick this up from finance and advise whether a micro-deposit is required or if the bank letter + voided check combo is sufficient?

Appreciate it,
Jonas
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Lena + Jonas —

Thanks for the updates and the voided check — that gives us the verification we need for ACH onboarding. I initiated the vendor record in our AP system this morning; provisional vendor ID is VND-27491. Next steps from Finance: 

- I'll run a micro-deposit verification this afternoon and post the two small test deposit values here when complete. Micro-deposit step is our standard for new ACH payees; if the values match, we flip the vendor to active for ACH.
- Please confirm whether Upscale will accept a net-30 payment term. If you require different terms, flag that now so we can set them on the vendor profile.
- PO mapping: we will consume the remit_sample_v2.csv. We will map your PO_TYPE field to our internal tag and expect InvoiceID and PO to be populated. If you can include a small sample invoice PDF for testing mapping against the CSV, that would be useful.

Lena: uploading the W-9 to the compliance folder and the bank letter as evidence.

Marissa Cole
